title.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

description.zh:
1931 年九一八事变至 1945 年日本签署投降书，中国人民进行了长达十四年的抗日战争。本专题以日军进攻、中国各抗日部队与盟军为主线，分设国民党军正面战场、集团军、八路军、新四军、华南游击队、中国政府、中国民众、国际组织与多边会议等实体，分别呈现正面战场部队序列、华北华中敌后根据地与政治外交事件，呈现从东北沦陷、全面抗战爆发、战略相持到最终胜利的时空脉络。

> 部分战役路线（淞沪、平型关、忻口、台儿庄、兰封、随枣、昆仑关、南京、武汉、长沙（第一、二、三次会战）、枣宜、上高、中条山、鄂西、常德、衡阳、湘西、滇西、百团、远征军/缅北、豫湘桂）据常见战史地图整理；其余路线为示意简化。2026-11-16 起按 C5—C7 端点核查计划分批核对线头线尾：日军进攻线 21 处已补灵丘、大同、青岛、菏泽、开封、商城、芜湖、归绥、舞阳、当阳、郑州、深圳、曼德勒、杭州、安阳、荆州、公安、邵阳等出兵或占领节点，一·二八段改为虹口—闸北，兰封段改为菏泽—兰封—开封，六安段改为六安—商城；中国军队的忻口、平型关、昆仑关、百团大战、上高、中条山、鄂西、滇西等 12 处与盟军/华南 6 处也已核对：忻口段改为南怀化—大白水战场线，百团大战西端校正至榆次并补正太路破袭事件，昆仑关段补第 5 军自柳州反攻，滇西反攻补保山强渡怒江与攻克畹町两端；华南游击队三条活动区尾端按示意线登记。2026-11-19 补录 1932—1936 年事件 26 条（锦州沦陷、榆关抗战、热河作战、长城抗战、察哈尔民众抗日同盟军、塘沽协定、何梅协定、秦土协定、绥远抗战等）与 12 段路线，填上伪满洲国成立至一二·九运动之间的空档。2026-11-19 起把「中国抗战力量」叙事链按参战部队拆分，并把原混合层进一步拆为「中国政府」与「中国民众」：删除阳泉—昆明等 10 段跨战区转场线，军事路线改挂国民党军正面战场、集团军、八路军与盟军，并补第74军、第5军、第10军、第33集团军、第18军等部队战史线。2026-11-19 另设「国际组织与多边会议」，把李顿调查团、国联大会通过报告书与九国公约会议从中国政府层移出，并补 1931 年中国向国联申诉事件。事件日期与地点仍待史料校订。
description.en:
From the Mukden Incident in September 1931 to Japan’s formal surrender in September 1945, China fought a fourteen-year war of resistance. This atlas follows the Japanese advance, China’s resistance forces, and the Allied forces, with separate layers for the KMT frontline forces, group armies, the Eighth Route Army, the New Fourth Army, South China guerrillas, the Chinese government, the Chinese people, and international organizations and multilateral conferences. It covers the frontline order of battle, the anti-Japanese base areas in North and Central China, and political and diplomatic events, from the fall of the Northeast and the outbreak of full-scale war to protracted resistance and final victory.

> Selected campaign routes (Shanghai, Pingxingguan, Xinkou, Taierzhuang, Lanfeng, Suizao, Kunlun Pass, Nanjing, Wuhan, Changsha (first, second, and third battles), Zaoyang–Yichang, Shanggao, South Shanxi, West Hubei, Changde, Hengyang, West Hunan, Western Yunnan, Hundred Regiments, the Expeditionary Force/Northern Burma, and Henan-Hunan-Guangxi) follow common historical maps; other routes remain simplified. From 16 November 2026 the C5–C7 endpoint review checks heads and tails in batches: the 21 Japanese advance endpoints now carry documented departure or capture nodes (Lingqiu, Datong, Qingdao, Heze, Kaifeng, Shangcheng, Wuhu, Guisui, Wuyang, Dangyang, Zhengzhou, Shenzhen, Mandalay, Hangzhou, Anyang, Jingzhou, Gong’an, Shaoyang), the January 28 leg becomes Hongkou–Zhabei, Lanfeng becomes Heze–Lanfeng–Kaifeng and Lu’an becomes Lu’an–Shangcheng; the 12 Chinese and 6 Allied/South China endpoints have also been checked: the Xinkou leg now follows the Nanhuaihua–Dabaishui battle line, the Hundred Regiments line is corrected to Yuci with a documented railway-sabotage event, Kunlun Pass gains the 5th Corps’ departure from Liuzhou, and the western Yunnan counter-offensive is anchored at the Salween crossing and Wanding; the three South China guerrilla area tails are registered as schematic activity zones. On 19 November 2026, 26 events and 12 route segments were added for 1932–1936 (the fall of Jinzhou, the defense of Shanhaiguan, the Rehe campaign, the Great Wall campaign, the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army, the Tanggu Truce, the He-Umezu and Qin-Doihara agreements, and the Suiyuan campaign), filling the gap between the establishment of Manchukuo and the December Ninth Movement. From 19 November 2026 the “Chinese resistance” narrative chain was split by participating units, and the mixed layer was further divided into “Chinese Government” and “Chinese People”: ten cross-theater connector segments (including Yangquan–Kunming) were removed, military routes were reassigned to the KMT frontline, group-army, Eighth Route Army, and Allied layers, and unit histories were added for the 74th, 5th, 10th, and 18th Armies and the 33rd Group Army. On 19 November 2026 a separate “International Organizations and Multilateral Conferences” layer was added: the Lytton Commission, the League Assembly’s adoption of its report, and the Nine-Power Conference were moved out of the Chinese government layer, and China’s 1931 appeal to the League was added. Dates and coordinates still await historical review.

description.zh: 自 1931 年九一八事变起，日本关东军及后续侵华部队在中国东北、华北、华中、华南的进攻方向，路线为示意简化。
description.en: Advance directions of the Japanese Kwantung Army and subsequent invasion forces in Northeast, North, Central, and South China from 1931; routes are simplified.

description.zh: 国民政府及其战时政治、外交、经济与军事决策；军事行动路线已按部队拆分到国民党军、集团军、八路军、盟军等实体。
description.en: The Nationalist government and its wartime political, diplomatic, economic, and military decisions; military routes have been reassigned to the KMT, group-army, Eighth Route Army, and Allied layers.

description.zh: 国际联盟、九国公约会议等多边组织与会议的调查、调处与决议；行为主体是国际组织或会议，不是中国政府。
description.en: Investigations, mediation, and resolutions by the League of Nations, the Nine-Power Conference, and other multilateral bodies; the actor is the international organization or conference, not the Chinese government.

description.zh: 学生、知识分子、社会团体、民众武装、难民与战时救援；不包含政府决策与军队作战。
description.en: Students, intellectuals, civic groups, people’s armed forces, refugees, and wartime relief; government decisions and military operations are excluded.

name.en: Allied Forces and Chinese Expeditionary Force

description.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国与美、英等盟国在中缅印战区协同作战；路线表现中国远征军入缅、撤退与缅北反攻。
description.en: After the Pacific War began, China fought alongside the United States, Britain, and other Allies in the China-Burma-India theater; routes show the Chinese Expeditionary Force’s entry into Burma, retreat, and the northern Burma counteroffensive.

description.zh: 国民革命军正面战场部队与作战序列；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: National Revolutionary Army frontline units and order of battle; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军第八路军及其华北敌后根据地；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: The Eighth Route Army and its base areas in North China; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军陆军新编第四军及其华中敌后根据地；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: The New Fourth Army and its base areas in Central China; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 东江纵队、琼崖纵队等华南抗日武装；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: South China anti-Japanese forces including the Dongjiang and Qiongya columns; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军集团军层级部队与作战序列；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: National Revolutionary Army group armies and their order of battle; routes are simplified and await historical review.
